_notes: No passwords here: the service logs in to SQL Server with its Windows account (Integrated Security=True).
TrustServerCertificate=True is for local DEVELOPMENT only; the server refuses to start in Production with it.
Encrypt=Optional is accepted only because SQL Server runs on this same PC (shared memory, nothing crosses the network).
CertificateThumbprint and AllowedHosts: written by New-HccCertificate.ps1 -UpdateConfig (AllowedHosts = this PC's names and addresses; '*' is refused).
LoopbackHttpPort 5080 is the plain-HTTP setup listener (setup only, no sign-in); Initialize-HccProperty.ps1 sets it to 0 after first-time setup.
PublicPort stays 0 unless the booking website goes on the internet: then follow INSTALL.md section 10 (separate listener behind a reverse proxy, KnownProxies).
Hcc:GuestIdKeys is added by New-HccGuestIdKey.ps1; this file must then be readable only by SYSTEM, Administrators and the service (checked at start-up).
